title: Old Vanilla Glint
description: Restores Minecraft's original enchantment glint for a classic visual experience.
body:
# ✨ Old Vanilla Glint

## 🌊 Overview

Old Vanilla Glint restores the iconic enchantment effect from older Minecraft versions. By replacing the modern glint with the classic animated shine, enchanted items regain the familiar appearance that many players remember from Minecraft's early days.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ⚔ Features

• Restores the classic enchantment glint

• Brings back the original enchanted item appearance

• Applies to enchanted items and armor

• Clean and nostalgic visual style

• Lightweight and easy to use

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🎮 Perfect For

• Classic Minecraft enthusiasts

• Vanilla+ resource pack users

• PvP players

• Nostalgia-focused pack collections

• Players who prefer the original enchantment effect

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
